known_failure.query: What command sequence starts the services and verifies readiness before benchmarking?
known_failure.analysis: BM25 and dense individually retrieve the relevant source within top 5, but on different chunks. Chunk-ID-level reciprocal-rank fusion rewards overlapping README chunks and collapses source diversity.

release_decision.reason: Hybrid plus reranking improves Top-1 accuracy and MRR but regresses Recall@5 on one frozen case. The locked benchmark will not be tuned after observing this failure. Source-aware fusion should be developed on a separate development set and validated on a fresh locked test.

scope_note: Controlled repository-documentation benchmark; not a claim of general real-world RAG accuracy.
